channel.title: Camp Details :: KS LEAPES
channel.description: The KS-LEAPES summer camp uses a unique distributed model - schools across the state of Kansas host local camps, offering a curriculum developed and led by K-State faculty. Camp activities include a mixture of hands-on, asynchronous activities, virtual tours of research and manfacturing facilties, and synchronous discussions with K-State faculty, industry leaders, and more! Important Dates June 3, 9:00am-3:00pm Teacher PD Session June 8-11, 9:00am-12:00pm Computer Science Week
